tasks.question: What work-related fatalities did Siemens report for fiscal 2025, distinguishing own workforce from other workers and injury-related from work-related-ill-health fatalities?

What fiscal-2030 Scope 1 and 2 and Scope 3 reduction targets did Siemens report, including baseline year, baseline emissions, target reductions, fiscal-2025 progress, organizational subject and relevant methodological exclusions or adjustments?
What is the consolidation boundary of Siemens' Sustainability Statement, how does it cover own operations and the upstream and downstream value chain, and how is Siemens Healthineers treated?

What total gross Scope 3 emissions and Category 3.11 use-of-sold-products emissions did Siemens report for fiscal 2025, and what calculation boundary, assumptions, exclusions and primary-data limitation apply to Category 3.11 and Scope 3?
